social_circle.name: Teresa Mosquera Ramirez

demographics.education: some college and medical billing certificate

background.how_they_met: Teresa is Alicia's eldest daughter, raised by Alicia and Manuel in their Catholic, food-centered family home.
background.why_close: Teresa is Alicia's most regular family check-in, helps with online health forms, tax documents, medical portals, and emotional support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in full sentences, often with reminders, links, and quick check-ins; mixes English and Spanish phrases and follows up with phone calls.

recent_text_topics: Checking Alicia's and Manuel's appointment times, blood pressure notes, and portal messages.
Sending Alicia articles or official health information and helping interpret clinic instructions.
Talking through Teresa's own work and family stress when she needs to breathe and be heard.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Teresa lives in Fresno and calls almost every evening; Q18 says Teresa helped Alicia use the health portal after a missed lab-result call; Q36 says Teresa helps with online medical forms; Q44 says Teresa checked the portal and reminded Alicia she did not have to handle every detail alone; Q75 says Teresa helps gather tax documents.

social_circle.name: Marisol Mosquera Ortega

demographics.education: high school graduate with community college coursework

background.how_they_met: Marisol is Alicia's youngest adult daughter and grew up in Alicia and Manuel's household.
background.why_close: Marisol keeps Alicia connected to grandchildren and daily family life through texts and photos, especially because she lives farther away than Teresa.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Sends frequent photo texts, short updates, hearts, and voice notes when busy; often uses WhatsApp for pictures.

recent_text_topics: Photos of the children and grandchildren, including school events and family errands.
Planning what desserts or drinks the younger relatives should bring to Alicia's next family meal.
Checking whether Alicia needs anything from Bakersfield before a visit.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 names Marisol as Alicia's daughter in Bakersfield and says she sends texts and photos of the kids during the week; Q05 also describes family gatherings as food-centered; Q48 says Alicia uses WhatsApp for family photos and quick messages.

social_circle.name: Elena Ortega

demographics.occupation: part-time photographer and community college student
demographics.education: some college, currently taking community college classes

background.how_they_met: Elena is Alicia's granddaughter through Marisol's family.
background.why_close: Elena visits Alicia regularly, helps with phone settings, photographs Alicia's garden, and shows interest in family history and recipes.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses casual texts with photos, screenshots, and step-by-step phone help; more emoji-friendly than Alicia but still respectful.

recent_text_topics: Sending Alicia photos of the tomato and chili plants from her last visit.
Walking Alicia through phone settings and WhatsApp photo storage.
Asking Alicia for details for the family memoir, including recipes and stories from Fresno County.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Elena visits about twice a month, helps Alicia with phone settings, and likes to photograph Alicia's garden; Q108 says Alicia wants to finish a memoir with recipes, stories, photos, and family tree; Q48 says Alicia uses WhatsApp for family photos.

social_circle.name: Carmen Vargas

background.how_they_met: Carmen is Alicia's younger sister; they grew up together in Fresno County in a bilingual Mexican American Catholic household.
background.why_close: They share childhood memories, Spanish-language family culture, Catholic faith, and a habit of checking on each other after Sunday Mass.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts mostly in Spanish or Spanglish, with short practical notes, prayer messages, and occasional voice notes instead of long typing.

recent_text_topics: Sunday Mass, parish news, and who needs prayers that week.
Comparing family memories for Alicia's memoir and checking old recipe details.
Checking on Manuel's diabetes and Alicia's blood pressure after recent appointments.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Alicia has one living sister, Carmen, in Fresno, and that they talk in Spanish on Sundays after Mass; Q38 says Alicia calls her sister when upset; Q17 says Alicia checks in with her sister every Sunday.

social_circle.name: Rosa Martinez

demographics.occupation: retired grocery clerk and parish volunteer

background.how_they_met: Rosa and Alicia became close through church and senior center activities in Coalinga.
background.why_close: They share Catholic faith, senior-center routines, chair yoga, coffee after Mass, prayer support, and mutual aid through meals and phone trees.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Sends short, warm texts with prayer requests, reminders, and check-ins; likely uses simple punctuation and occasional religious images or forwarded parish notices.

recent_text_topics: Coordinating who is bringing food or helping with parish meals.
Checking whether Alicia is coming to chair yoga or resting her knee.
Sharing prayer requests after Manuel's blood sugar worries and news of church friends getting sick.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Rosa as one of Alicia's small circle of church and senior-center women friends; Q07 says they do chair yoga, help with meals, sit with coffee after Mass, trade garden vegetables, recipes, prayer requests, books, and make a phone tree if someone is sick; Q44 says Alicia asked Rosa to pray with her after Mass.
